positions.as_written: Assess varus, external rotation and posterior laxity together when a corner injury is suspected.
Examine under anaesthetic, since the findings are subtle and the imaging inconsistent.
Expect apportionment within the corner to be less settled than between corner and cruciate.
Treat the corner as the structure whose assessment belongs in every cruciate operation.
Assess the corner under anaesthetic in every cruciate reconstruction.
Document peroneal nerve function before and after corner surgery.
Expect a chronic corner injury not to improve without surgery.
